claim_ceiling: A source-pinned low-density air PIV tracer/image-resolution envelope. It does not validate a complete EHD thruster, produce physical tracer corrections, or establish suitability for Mars CO2 or true vacuum.

source.title: Particle Image Velocimetry for Ion Wind Thruster Measurement in Low Density Atmosphere

cohort.voltage_role: low-thrust tracer/corona interaction test; chosen to minimize ion-wind interference with imposed inlet flow
cohort.electrode_system: two 120 um gold-covered tungsten wires and NACA0010 aluminum-function collector

diagnostic_contract.analysis_selection: best image selected; source table is a feasibility screen, not replicated uncertainty distribution
diagnostic_contract.parenthetical_table_values: edge-case extraction; quantitative values may exist but full flow field not available

source_table.resolution_metric: reported PIV interrogation area size in pixels; smaller is higher spatial resolution

corona_on_off_test.result: large flow maps near emitter appeared nearly identical with corona off/on; slight downstream change and local emitter wake in some cases
corona_on_off_test.inference_limit: not a high-thrust or full operating-envelope passivity test

collector_surface_materials.optical_result: diffuse scattering and overexposure near boundary layer

collector_surface_materials.electrical_result: no change observed at 8 kV; higher voltage remains unqualified

collector_surface_materials.optical_result: best near-wall image clarity among tested options
collector_surface_materials.electrical_boundary: maintains aluminum function without added paint coating

separate_qualification_axes.optical_adequacy: measured image quality and correlation; retain vector masks and interrogation-window metadata
separate_qualification_axes.dynamic_fidelity: independent velocity reference and declared tracer Stokes/response evidence
separate_qualification_axes.electrical_passivity: independent baseline versus corona/tracer intervention; simultaneous current/voltage where possible
separate_qualification_axes.pressure_availability: source-supported pressure range only; missing/failed tracer density remains unavailable, not zero
separate_qualification_axes.spatial_resolution: declare region-specific resolution target; 32x32 px was reported insufficient for boundary-layer resolution in this study
separate_qualification_axes.persistence: post-removal electrode inspection/current recovery receipt where tracer contamination/deposition may persist

prospective_benchmark_targets.no_cross_regime_transfer: do not transfer low-density air results into CO2 or true vacuum without new evidence
prospective_benchmark_targets.no_passivity_from_image_quality: good PIV correlation alone is not a passivity result
prospective_benchmark_targets.no_boundary_layer_claim: do not report boundary-layer resolution from a window size already shown insufficient for the declared boundary-layer scale
prospective_benchmark_targets.physical_observer_effect: apply EHD-DPM-001 active and post-removal receipt where diagnostic intervention may alter the state
